reflections.summary: Won because the preview plan matched the opponent perfectly: Spiritomb's early Will-O-Wisp crippled Annihilape's Rage Fist (it did only ~77% to Meta even at +2 via Defiant), and Mega Metagross's Tough Claws attacks out-damaged Grimmsnarl's screens — the foe wasted turns re-setting Reflect (even at 20% HP on turn 10) instead of attacking, and the turn-10 Zen Headbutt + Flare Blitz double-up removed Annihilape, leaving burned Grimmsnarl to be finished. Bringing Spiritomb/Incineroar/Aerodactyl/Mega
reflections.adjustment: For G2 expect the foe to swap in Talonflame and/or Maushold: lead Aerodactyl + Metagross for immediate 4x Rock Slide pressure on Talonflame and spread damage through Follow Me Maushold (Wide Guard does NOT stop Population Bomb), keep Incineroar in the back until Annihilape is dead (Defiant turned Intimidate into +2 last game), and when a KO needs securing, double up rather than trust a single 90% Meteor Mash.
reflections.notebook: G1 won; plan validated — Spiritomb burn on Annihilape is the linchpin (burned Rage Fist did ~77% to Meta even at +2). Durable foe tendencies: Grimmsnarl prioritizes screens over attacking even at low HP (re-set Reflect at 20%); Annihilape Protects often when not Taunted; their only Mega is Gengar (died early G1 — may be led or preserved differently G2). G1 they benched Maushold/Talonflame — high chance both appear G2: Rock Slide 4x Talonflame, Maushold 144-179 Spe outspeeds Meta 162, Wide Guard does NOT stop Population Bomb. Never Intimidate/Parting Shot into Annihilape (Defiant +2 confirmed). Mash/ZH both 90% acc — two Mash misses in G1; double up to secure KOs. Damage chart reminder: Fire NEUTRAL vs Grimmsnarl here; Mash vs Grimmsnarl ~94-180% no Reflect, ~47-90% through Reflect; ZH+Flare Blitz vs Annihilape min ~103%. G2 PLAN: lead Aerodactyl+Meta (Rock Slide/Tailwind), Spiritomb for burn, Incineroar held back until Annihilape dead; kill Rage Fist user with few big hits, never Rock Slide it early.

reflections.summary: Lost because team-preview (Mega Gengar + Grimmsnarl screens + Ape + Primarina) mismatched the opponent's Meta/Aero/Spiritomb/Incin core: Shadow Tag useless vs Ghost Spiritomb, screens broken by Aero Taunt/Tailwind, and no reliable late answer once Ape was burned then crit-KO'd by Meta Zen.
reflections.adjustment: Change the four and Mega choice next game—bench Gengar (or do not Mega it) and prioritize a Meta-resistant lead/support structure that keeps Ape healthy and denies Aero Taunt/Tailwind value.
